+## 1. The story in one paragraph
+Evaluating a new model on N benchmarks is costly; leaderboards hold a history matrix of M models x N benchmarks. An evaluator can run only k benchmarks and wants the other N-k scores. Outline revision 2 changes my figure plan, and I've updated Fig. 2 to match. Still no real figures: result files and venue sizes haven't arrived, so everything I've run was on a fake data set kept outside the repo.

- **Fig. 2:** it now draws two predictors, PPCA and the best simple predictor, so k* can be read per predictor. Colour marks the selector, and line style and marker fill mark the predictor. I assumed `best_simple` as the name for the second predictor in the result files. I rendered it on the fake data and it reads cleanly; the legend takes some space.
- **Plan changes:** Fig. 5 shows the three theory tiers as three curves in one panel. Fig. 6 starts as a table. Fig. 7 (history sweep) goes to the appendix first. Table 2 gets rows for the small-N LLM matrices.
- **Reproduction notes:** the README now serves as the figure/table-to-script map. Finished figures and the scripts will go to `figures/`, `tables/` and `figures/src/` on `paper-repo` `dev`, which `CODEOWNERS` assigns to me.
- **Pushed and logged:** the Fig. 2 change and README update are on `main`, and a note is on `figtab-repo`#2.

Next step: when `experiment-repo` (#2) and `venue-repo` (#2) answer, I'll build the remaining figures and tables, set the venue values, and deliver the finished PDFs.
